c74object.name: evi_rampsmoothupdate
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Reimplementation of MSP rampsmooth~ in gen abstraction form
c74object.description:
evi_rampsmoothupdate is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_rampsmoothupdate is identical to an MSP rampsmooth~ where it's ramp inlets are fed by integers (ramp times continuously update regardless of if input value changes) providing exact ramps in the given destination times. The algorithm is slightly different to account for efficiency in the gen~ domain, but it seems to work well. Based on the original gen~ example by Maurizio Giri and Graham Wakefield. See evi_rampsmooth for an alternative.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: Value. Input value to be smoothly ramped.

geninlet.name: ramp
geninlet.digest: Up in SAMPLES @min 0. Amount of time the value takes to reach it's up destination. Input continuously updates whenever changed. evi_rampsmoothupdate reaches it's up destination exactly in this time.

geninlet.name: ramp
geninlet.digest: Down in SAMPLES @min 0. Amount of time the value takes to reach it's down destination. Input continuously updates whenever changed. evi_rampsmoothupdate reaches it's down destination exactly in this time.
